class.name: DSProfiler
class.brief_description: Performance profiling and NVMe transfer throughput monitor for DirectStorage.
class.description: [DSProfiler] tracks read workload durations and bytes transferred, storing recent workload history in a bounded ring buffer (up to 1024 entries). The extension registers it as the [Engine] singleton named [code]"DSProfiler"[/code]. [method register_performance_monitors] adds [code]"directstorage/throughput_mbps"[/code] and related queue depth monitors to Godot's [Performance] monitors.

method.name: get_last_bytes
method.description: Returns the total bytes read in the last profiled workload.

method.name: get_last_duration_us
method.description: Returns the microsecond duration of the last profiled workload.

method.name: get_last_result
method.description: Returns the most recently recorded [DSProfilerResult] metric report, or [code]null[/code] if no workload has been recorded.

method.name: get_last_throughput_mbps
method.description: Returns the calculated transfer throughput in megabytes per second (MB/s).

method.name: get_queue_depth
method.description: Returns the current DirectStorage pending request queue depth.

method.name: get_result_history
method.description: Returns an [Array] containing previously recorded [DSProfilerResult] instances representing profiling history.

method.name: record_result
method.description: Records a completed [DSProfilerResult] metric object into the profiler history and updates last-workload metrics.

method.name: record_workload
method.description: Records a completed read workload with the total [param bytes] and elapsed duration [param duration_us].

method.name: register_performance_monitors
method.description: Registers custom Performance monitors with Godot Engine's debugger system.

method.name: set_queue_depth
method.description: Sets the current queue depth metric recorded by the profiler.

method.name: unregister_performance_monitors
method.description: Unregisters custom Performance monitors from Godot Engine's debugger system.
